item.title: Arimenes #3324 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel
item.description: Arimenes #3324 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
